notes: Produced a PID controller tuned for the updated geometry with larger sensors and an added front sensor, aiming to improve line detection and reduce oscillations. Observation request expanded to include steering oscillation for better control smoothness analysis.
rationale: The previous iteration's baseline geometry with 5 sensors of size 0.012 m and wheel track 0.12 m showed good completion and low line loss on the oval track but went off track on the s-bend with one line loss event and increased oscillation. To improve line detection and stability, I increased sensor size to 0.016 m, added a central front sensor at y=0.06 m to better anticipate line curvature, and widened the wheel track to 0.14 m to enhance stability and reduce oscillations. The controller is adjusted with tuned PID gains to balance responsiveness and smoothness for the new sensor layout and geometry. I request measurements including completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, max_error, and steering_oscillation to evaluate the impact of these changes on line following robustness and control smoothness.
